attchmntText: Tera Software Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on November 11, 2026.
voiceSummary: Tera Software Limited approved un-audited financial results for the half-year ended September 30, 2026. The Board appointed Mr. G. Venkatanarayana as Chief Financial Officer effective December 04, 2026. The company approved a preferential issue of up to 5,14,491 fully convertible warrants to promoter group members Mr. T. Madhu Mitra and Mrs. T. Pavana Devi at Rs. 291.55 per security, aggregating up to Rs. 14,99,99,951. This proposal is subject to shareholder approval. The Board also approved changing the company name and altering the Memorandum of Association objects clause, both subject to member approval. An Extra-Ordinary General Meeting is convened to seek approval for these matters.

attchmntText: Tera Software Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026 and outcome of Board Meeting
voiceSummary: Tera Software Limited approved un-audited standalone and consolidated financial results for the half-year ended September 30, 2026. The company appointed Mr. G. Venkatanarayana as Chief Financial Officer effective December 4, 2026. The Board approved a preferential issue of convertible warrants to the promoter group, subject to shareholder approval. Proposals to change the company name and alter the Memorandum of Association were also approved, pending member approval. An Extra-Ordinary General Meeting is scheduled to seek shareholder consent for these matters. For the half-year ended September 30, 2026, the net profit was 1,324.82 lakhs, compared to 1,115.83 lakhs in the corresponding period of the previous year. Earnings per share for the half-year stood at 10.14.
